findings.evidence: grep: `IsKinematicStabilizer` occurs only in `EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean` (lines 523, 535, 539, 546, 571, 863, 1140, 1168) and is inside `namespace Hadronic` (opened line 417, closed 1188) — note the PR description misattributes it to `Leptonic`. Its structure body at 523-530 matches the new 109-115 field for field.
findings.fix: Add one pair-indexed predicate next to `IsIsometry`/`reflect` in `Tensors/Basic.lean`'s `Bilin` namespace (lines 141-194), e.g. `structure Bilin.IsPairStabilizer (g : Bilin V) (a b : V) (f : V →ₗ[ℝ] V) : Prop where isometry; fixes_left; fixes_right`, plus `Bilin.pairing_invariant_of_fixed`. Then define `Hadronic.IsKinematicStabilizer g K f := Bilin.IsPairStabilizer g K.p K.q f` (only 8 in-file uses: lines 523, 535, 539, 546, 571, 863, 1140, 1168; no other file references it) and use `Bilin.IsPairStabilizer g p p'` here, deleting `IsElasticStabilizer`.
findings.issue: `IsElasticStabilizer g p p' f` (isometry + two fixed vectors) is a second copy of the existing `EpsilonEridani.QFT.Scattering.DIS.Tensors.Hadronic.IsKinematicStabilizer g K f` (`Tensors/Basic.lean:523-530`: `isometry`, `fixes_p`, `fixes_q`), the same notion up to field names — the file's own docstring (lines 107-108) says fixing `p, p'` is the same as fixing `p, q`, which is exactly the pair the existing predicate stabilises. The split means lemmas proved for one do not apply to the other, e.g. `Hadronic.pairing_invariant_of_fixed` (`Tensors/Basic.lean:538-542`) is unavailable to the elastic case.

findings.evidence: Side-by-side: new lines 144-147 vs existing `Tensors/Basic.lean:571-574` — same tactic-free structure instance, same three supporting lemmas from `Bilin`.
findings.fix: Prove it once as `Bilin.reflect_isPairStabilizer (g) (hSymm) (u) (hu) (hua) (hub) : Bilin.IsPairStabilizer g a b (Bilin.reflect g u)` in the `Bilin` namespace, derive `Hadronic.reflect_isKinematicStabilizer` from it, and call it here with `a := p`, `b := p'` instead of restating it.
findings.issue: `reflect_isElasticStabilizer` re-proves `Hadronic.reflect_isKinematicStabilizer` (`Tensors/Basic.lean:569-574`): both have the identical three-field body `isometry := Bilin.reflect_isometry g hSymm u hu`, `Bilin.reflect_apply_of_orthogonal g u _ _` twice, under the same hypotheses `hu : g u u ≠ 0`, `g u p = 0`, `g u q/p' = 0`.

summary: The form factor, charge radius and single-pole material is genuinely new and reuses `Bilin.reflect`, `gWit` and `piPlus_charge` correctly. But `IsElasticStabilizer` and `reflect_isElasticStabilizer` are a field-for-field parallel API to the existing `Hadronic.IsKinematicStabilizer` and `Hadronic.reflect_isKinematicStabilizer`, and should be factored into one pair-indexed stabiliser in the `Bilin` namespace.
